name: CoCo-Pi - Community Edition 2026.11 RC6 (2026-11-11 CHDX update)
changes: Replace the seven legacy YA-DOS HDD menu entries with CHDX 0.1.0 for CoCo2/CoCo3 in MAME and XRoar.
Install the optional matched 3280-disk CHDX library through Maintenance: Update Utilities > Update CHDX HDD (CoCo HD Explorer). YA-DOS 0.5D ROM remains separate; no DriveWire server is needed.
Legacy HDD files are preserved; customized CHDX images are backed up before replacement. No SD image reflash or reboot is required.

fixes.description: Install verified TNFS v26.1015.1 if missing or incomplete; no reboot needed.
Disable automatic USB printer setup; retain CUPS and manual printing. No reboot needed.
Build/install MC6801 tools v1.2.0 and PL/M-09 0.4.2 with regression checks; preserve existing sim6809.
Prepare verified, already-downloaded MCX128 firmware for XRoar; preserve MAME ZIPs and custom raw ROMs. No reboot needed.
